name: AIQuick Security
tagline: Open-source, privacy-respecting malware scanner — ClamAV-backed with built-in rules, on-demand and scheduled scans, no telemetry.
description: A privacy-respecting, offline malware scanner. It uses the open-source ClamAV engine when it is installed (clamscan/clamdscan) and always applies its own built-in signature rules, so it still catches known-bad files even with no engine present. Run an on-demand scan of a folder or your whole account, or set up a scheduled scan. Virus definitions and rules only ever update when you explicitly ask — nothing updates automatically and nothing is ever phoned home. No telemetry. Lives in the system tray so a scan is one click away.
aiStack: Python (tkinter + CLI), ClamAV (optional clamscan/clamdscan), ctypes system tray
